sourceQuote: It aims to cultivate comprehensive engineering technical talents with a solid theoretical foundation in engineering thermophysics, the ability to design energy power systems, and innovative thinking. They can engage in scientific research, technology development, engineering design, and operation management in fields such as energy power, thermal engineering, refrigeration and air conditioning, and new energy.
targetQuote: 培养目标旨在培养具有扎实的工程热物理理论基础、动力系统设计能力和创新思维的综合工程技术人才They能够在能源动力、热工、制冷与空调、新能源等领域从事科学研究、技术开发、工程设计和运行管理。
